name: mirage
text: Parlay check 04:22 — bad news, straight: 7 more parlays settled and all 7 were buyer wins. Record is now 1 win, 15 losses, -$58.60 realized. Every one of the settled parlays was heavy-favorite legs (70-97% each) and nearly all hit, which our odds said should happen about half the time. Our quotes win those auctions exactly when other makers price them higher (they likely know something, like lineups or injuries). I just restricted live quoting to parlays where EVERY leg is 50% or less (the longshot side, where the real-results study says buyers win less than priced). If the longshot kind also loses over the next ~10 settled, I will switch the maker back to paper. Your loss stop is still off in your app (20% of the wallet is what it was); I strongly recommend turning it on.
